### IDEA-A-0001

- Problem: Community default explanations for failures in natural-COCO-objects may be wrong; we test core SAM-OBJECTNESS.

- Important: Changes whether we adapt encoders, prompts, metrics, or data.
- Novel: Not a new module; a causal test of SAM-OBJECTNESS under invert in natural-COCO-objects.
- MinExp: Two-condition A/B on a public natural-COCO-objects split; freeze all but the hypothesized component; report Dice/NSD/IoU-cal plus a control metric.
- Risk: Closest eval papers may already contain the observation without the intervention.
- Cluster: SAM-OBJECTNESS
